# Northwind Communications — Network Outage and 911 Notification Procedures (excerpt)

## Network footprint

Switching is in the Riverside Central Office (CLLI RVSDMOXA01T) and the Kingsley Central Office (CLLI KNGSMOXA02T). The mobile core is at MTSO East; internet transit lands at POP DEN1 where the network peers as AS64500 and AS64501.

Cell Site 4417 and Cell Site 4418 cover the interstate corridor. Fiber Ring 3 links both central offices over cable CBL-0442. Cable service runs from Headend North through Hub 7 and Node 3B-14.

## PSAPs served

The selective router delivers 911 calls to Lake County 911 and Harbor City 911. Notify both PSAPs no later than 30 minutes after discovering an outage that affects 911 service.

## Regulators

The Regulatory Compliance Director files NORS reports with the FCC and outage reports with the state public utility commission. CPNI breaches go to the Secret Service and FBI through the central reporting facility.
